The *Tissametteyyamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 6) is an exegetical treatise belonging to the *Cūḷaniddesa*, situated among the late canonical collections of the Pali Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text serves as an extensive canonical commentary (*niddesa*) on the verses of the questions posed by the young student Tissametteyya (*Tissametteyyamāṇavapucchā*) from the Pārāyanavagga of the Sutta Nipāta [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral documents two modern translations into two languages [SuttaCentral]. No specific references or analyses concerning this chapter were identified in the secondary literature corpus provided.
